revisions.purpose: Release 0.3.30. A Hurricane version that learns from the NIMS SuperCon datasheet and is checked on time windows (scores.kind is time-windows, with a temporal block) gets its own captions, design stage, window-by-window validation bars, new-family answers, model card, tour text and details block; a version scored on folds takes the same code paths as before. Hurricane's baseline demo compares with the latest released version scored on folds. In Candidates the unconventional list comes first and is the default, and a strip names the compounds Hurricane gives the highest score, any recorded check on them and the version that screened the list. The liquid-nitrogen label of the data stage moves off a bar that crosses it. Version 0.3.30 in the service worker, the app constant and the cache name. The app changes no model result, candidate, score or threshold.
